name: @waf-harness/ace-rsi-toolkit
description: The ACE RSI Toolkit: Agentic Context Engineering (Zhang et al., 2025, https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04618), the sequential offline algorithm — a Reflector reads each training Trace, a Curator folds the lessons into a playbook of rules the Target reads before every task, and the final playbook is measured on the frozen Benchmark. Self-contained: it creates the Target's playbook Skill, evaluates its own cells and writes the Evaluation Center's scoreboard.

wafh.short_description: ACE RSI Toolkit: evolve a playbook from Traces.

quick_start.prompt: Use the `ace-rsi-toolkit` Skill to run ACE on an agent of this Project: ask me for the Test Agent and the published Benchmark to train on, initialize the playbook, run one epoch at the smoke budget, and report the baseline and final scores.

wafh.title: ACE RSI Toolkit
